title: selinum copticum
intro: Selinum copticum, commonly known as Egyptian parsley or Coptic celery, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb that has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Selinum copticum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, and protect against various diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disorders.
